## Codebase and issue tracking

`childes-db` is all open source and under active development. If you run into
an issue, please file it on the GitHub issue tracker of the appropriate
repository:

- Database and extraction method:
  [github.com/langcog/childes-db](https://github.com/langcog/childes-db)
- R package: [github.com/langcog/childesr](https://github.com/langcog/childesr)
- Python package: [github.com/langcog/childespy](https://github.com/langcog/childespy)
- Website frontend:
  [github.com/langcog/childes-db-website](https://github.com/langcog/childes-db-website)

If you have questions about `childes-db` or want to stay updated on changes to
the database, visualizations, or API, join our announcement
[mailing list](https://mailman.stanford.edu/mailman/listinfo/childes-db), or
email us at childes-db-contact (at) stanford (dot) edu.

## Treatment of CHAT format

The `childes-db` project stores CHILDES data in a relational database. The
original CHAT files were converted to XML via chatter, a cross-platform
application provided by TalkBank. The XML files were then parsed in Python and
imported into a MySQL database through Django. The annotations and markers
from the original CHAT files that are preserved in `childes-db` are listed in
the table below:


## Database versioning

One of the principal design goals for `childes-db` is to ensure
reproducibility in analyses. The database is versioned, and both the API and
the visualizations report the database version for each analysis. We recommend
that authors report both with their analyses. To reproduce an earlier
analysis, previous [releases](data.html) of the database are directly
accessible through both the R and Python APIs.
